name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any website for the reasons a brand is missing, misrepresented or ignored by AI assistants, and for the reasons visitors who do arrive leave again. Emits one prioritised report of findings and fixes.

skills.summary: Crawls the site once, runs the six sub-skills over that snapshot, deduplicates and prioritises their findings, and emits report.json and report.md.
Gate A: is the crawler let in at all? robots.txt, AI crawler user agents, bot managers, sitemaps, status codes, noindex and canonicals.
Gate A/C: can a machine read what is delivered? JavaScript shells, facts locked in images, PDFs, video or iframes.
Gate C: are the facts machine-readable? JSON-LD presence, validity, completeness and agreement with the visible page, keyed to detected page type.
Gate C: is there a sentence an assistant could quote? Entity definition, answer-first sections, core facts, naming consistency.
Mechanism D: is the brand current, corroborated across independent sources, and distinguishable from others sharing its name?
Mechanism G: does a visitor who arrives mid-journey get oriented, given a next step, and able to get back?
